name: Owner config (the owner's hosts this device uses)
purpose: ~/.config/powos/owner.conf: the owner's hub/Mac/GPU endpoints (board host, root shell, terminals' links, ship gate, speech servers) that make this one of the owner's devices; written by powos-deviced owner-apply (enrollment's owner bundle; for this OnePlus, rooted.sh deploy renders tools/phone/owner.json with it). Not a secret. Without it the device runs standalone
installedBy: powos devices enroll / targets/android/rooted/rooted.sh deploy -> powos-deploy.sh
